_note: Run under the method venv (the tests need torch): .venvs/27_ibot/bin/python bin/mutate.py --spec mutations/27_ibot-single-layer.json. This proves tests/test_method_27_ibot.py's single-canonical-layer assertion is not vacuous. iBOT's official ViT-S recipe probes the teacher with the last four blocks' CLS tokens concatenated (a 4x-wide, 1536-d multi-layer feature); this port ships the single canonical final feature instead (n_last_blocks=1, 384-d) per BASIC5_FAIR_v1 rule d. The provider reads n_last_blocks from the shipped config, so flipping the config back to 4 makes the saved feature 1536-d, which must break the width assertion -- the port cannot silently drift back to iBOT's multi-layer concatenation.
